summary: MR Health, a technology-enabled diagnostics platform in Kampala, is hiring a Senior Healthcare Partnerships & Business Development Manager to build a partner network that generates a consistent pipeline of diagnostic bookings.
description:
**MR Health** is a technology-enabled diagnostics platform making healthcare more convenient through home sample collection, preventive health packages and digital diagnostic bookings. We partner with leading laboratories to bring high-quality diagnostic services directly to patients while helping healthcare providers generate additional revenue.

We are looking for a highly connected and results-driven **Healthcare Partnerships & Business Development Manager** to lead the expansion of the MR Health partner network across **Kampala**.

This is **not** a traditional pharmaceutical sales role. Your primary responsibility is to establish strategic partnerships that generate a consistent pipeline of diagnostic bookings for MR Health.

## Pharmacy partnerships

- Identify and onboard high-traffic pharmacies across Kampala
- Meet pharmacy owners and branch managers to introduce the MR Health partnership program
- Negotiate referral partnerships
- Coordinate installation of MR Health standees and QR codes at partner locations
- Train pharmacy staff on how patients can book through MR Health

## Clinic & hospital partnerships

- Build relationships with private clinics, medical centres and hospitals that do not operate comprehensive in-house diagnostic laboratories
- Position MR Health as their preferred diagnostics partner
- Develop long-term referral agreements
- Conduct regular follow-up visits to maintain partner engagement

## Corporate partnerships

- Identify and approach companies interested in employee wellness programs
- Secure recurring corporate health screening contracts
- Work with HR and management teams to organise annual and periodic health screening initiatives
- Build a portfolio of corporate clients generating consistent monthly diagnostic volumes

## Relationship management

- Maintain strong relationships with existing partners
- Identify new business opportunities within the healthcare ecosystem
- Represent MR Health professionally during meetings and industry events
- Provide regular market intelligence and competitor insights

## Ideal candidate

We are looking for someone who already has established relationships across Kampala's healthcare sector. Preferred backgrounds include:

- Senior Pharmaceutical Medical Representative
- Diagnostic Laboratory Business Development Manager
- Healthcare Partnerships Manager
- Medical Sales Manager
- Hospital Business Development Executive

## Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of healthcare sales or business development experience
- Strong existing relationships with pharmacy owners, clinic managers, hospital administrators and corporate decision-makers
- Demonstrated ability to negotiate commercial partnerships
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Self-driven and comfortable working independently in the field
- A valid driving licence is an advantage

## Success metrics (first 6 months)

- Onboard 50+ pharmacy partners
- Establish partnerships with private clinics and hospitals across Kampala
- Secure recurring corporate wellness clients
- Build a partner network that consistently generates diagnostic bookings for MR Health
- Develop long-term relationships that contribute sustainable monthly revenue

## Compensation

- Competitive monthly retainer
- Attractive performance-based commission
- Milestone bonuses for partnership targets
- Flexible engagement options available for exceptional candidates

If you are passionate about transforming healthcare access in Uganda and already have a strong healthcare network, we would love to hear from you.
